Hannah Seiler

Bankruptcy Legal Assistant

Hannah works directly with clients during the prefiling stage, guiding them through document collection and the initial steps of the bankruptcy process. She holds a bachelor’s degree in sociology with a minor in social justice and brings a compassionate, client-centered approach to her work. With a professional background in banking, Hannah combines financial knowledge and attention to detail to support clients during challenging times.
